text:
Cuban of caña of azúcar,
Cuban of rosa and clavel,
Cuban of río and palmera,
with sol and salina in the piel.


Especias that pican and encienden
are menos that tú in the danzón,
Cuban of dientes preciosos,
precioso and febril heart.


Cuban, guajira and meneo
with rítmico and rápido pie,
the falda incendiada of sexo,
the boca olorosa a café.


the seno apretado and mordiente,
of brusco and carnoso temblor,
cortado of beso and mordisco,
quemado of sangre and sudor.


Cuban caliente and bonita,
bonita and caliente eres tú,
suave of hierbas and erguida
in tallo of fino bambú.


and the dejo in the voz cariciosa,
untada of tórtolas
and sedosa of plumas and espumas
to the darme the mimos a mí.


Cuban in the espesa manigua
with negro, mosquito and calor,
sonidos of huecas maracas
and truenos of congo tambor.


Cuban, guajira and refresco
of piña and of coco, and the are
batido, the tabaco veguero
and the vaso amarillo of ron.

translation.title: To a Cuban
